summary: Phase 2 end-to-end testing of Vastgoed Kiosk (AI assistent + PWA push + AES-256/QR PDFs). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass in test_phase2_modules.py covering AI chat (401 without auth, NL reply via Emergent LLM key, session persistence with history>=4 across two calls, GET history, DELETE clears session), Push (VAPID public key starts with 'B' + 87 chars, subscribe/unsubscribe upsert by endpoint, /push/test returns {sent:0,failed:0} with no real browser subs, /push/notify-overdue returns {sent,overdue_count,message} with correct count, AI sessie context bevat Jan de Vries + HUIS7A + bedragen), Secure PDF (encrypted=false returns >=30KB application/pdf met QR overlay, encrypted=true bevat /Encrypt object, /verify/{token} met geldig token levert valid:true + receipt_number + amount + currency, invalid token levert valid:false). Frontend: admin login OK, AI Assistent tab opent, suggestie 'Welke huurders heb ik in totaal?' geklikt, antwoord in het Nederlands rendered binnen 20s met portfolio context ('1 huurder Jan de Vries - HUIS7A - SRD 7000'), follow-up message verzonden + reply, Wis chat knop werkt. Notificaties tab toont 'Activeer notificaties' knop, secure-pdf helper text en /api/payments/{id}/secure-pdf endpoint zichtbaar. Betalingen tab toont 28 'Beveiligde PDF met QR verificatie' knoppen (ShieldCheck icon) naast elke Kwitantie PDF knop. /sw.js returns HTTP 200.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/payments/{id}/secure-pdf is PUBLIC (no auth) by design for share links but combined with QR + signed verify_token this is acceptable - just document it as intentional in API docs.

make_verify_token() uses HMAC-SHA256 truncated to 16 hex chars (~64 bits); for very high-value receipts consider full 32-char digest. Currently sufficient against guessing but borderline for long-lived PDFs.

ai_service.chat_send re-sends entire system+history per call (no LlmChat session resume), which works but doubles tokens on long sessions; acceptable for v1 since history capped at last 10 turns appended to system. Mention in PRD.
server.py is now ~1690 lines (added AI + push + secure-pdf in this iteration). Strongly recommend extracting routers in next refactor (auth, finance, contracts, ai, push, security).
Push subscribe stores raw keys.p256dh/auth in plaintext; this is standard for VAPID but mention in security notes.
pdf_security.encrypt_pdf uses pypdf clone_from=reader; for very large PDFs this is fine but secure_pdf always re-stamps QR even when encrypted=true — OK as overlay must happen before AES.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (AI chat reply, NL context, Notificaties tab, 28 Beveiligde PDF knoppen, sw.js 200)

seed_data_creation: AI sessie TEST_PH2_AI_SESSION created and cleaned. Push subscription TEST_PH2_FAKE_ENDPOINT created and cleaned. No persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env|cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. The /api/verify token test requires loading /app/backend/.env via load_dotenv in test (already done) because pytest sub-process doesn't inherit backend env JWT_SECRET. Frontend public URL is https://vastgoed-app.preview.emergentagent.com (NOT the URL in the original review_request). AI tab uses data-testid='tab-ai' and data-testid='tab-mobile-ai' (two elements due to responsive mobile bottom nav - use data-testid not get_by_text to avoid strict mode violation). Beveiligde PDF buttons are rendered as <a> elements (not <button>), use selector [title*='Beveiligde'] not button[title*='Beveiligde'].
rca of the issue: No issues found in Phase 2. One playwright selector hiccup: get_by_text('AI Assistent', exact=True) hits 2 nodes (sidebar + mobile bottom nav) - resolved by using [data-testid='tab-ai']. Beveiligde PDF action element is an anchor not a button - resolved by relaxing the selector.
